# PVF Calculator

> Free ASME B16.5/B16.9 pipe fitting weight calculators for procurement engineers, freight forwarders, and project managers. Accuracy: ±2% versus manufacturer catalog values.

PVF Calculator provides accurate, browser-based calculators for computing theoretical weights of flanges, pipe fittings, and pipe. All dimensional data comes from official ASME standards. The site is operated by a Cangzhou/Mengcun-based PVF manufacturer offering factory-direct FOB quotes.

## Calculators

- [Flange Weight Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/flange-weight-calculator/): Weld neck, slip-on, blind, socket weld, threaded — ASME B16.5, Class 150–2500, NPS ½"–24". Uses 3D geometric modeling, not flat-plate approximation.
- [Pipe Weight Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/pipe-weight-calculator/): ASME B36.10M pipe weight per meter and total length. NPS ½"–24", SCH 10–XXS. Carbon steel, stainless, alloy.
- [Elbow Weight Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/elbow-weight-calculator/): ASME B16.9 45° and 90° butt-weld elbows, long radius (1.5D) and short radius (1D).
- [Tee Weight Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/tee-weight-calculator/): ASME B16.9 equal and reducing tees with automatic branch/run size validation.
- [Reducer Weight Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/reducer-weight-calculator/): ASME B16.9 concentric and eccentric reducers, all standard combinations.
- [Valve Cv Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/valve-cv-calculator/): Size control and isolation valves from flow rate and pressure drop. Liquid, gas, steam.
- [Valve Weight Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/valve-weight-calculator/): Gate, globe, ball, check valves — Class 150–1500, NPS ½"–24".
- [Pressure Vessel Thickness Calculator](https://pvfcalculator.com/pressure-vessel-thickness-calculator/): ASME Section VIII UG-27/UG-32 minimum shell and head thickness for internal pressure.

## Reference Tools

- [Pipe Schedule Chart](https://pvfcalculator.com/pipe-schedule-chart/): Complete ASME B36.10M wall thickness chart, NPS ½"–24", SCH 10–XXS.
- [ASME B16.5 Flange Dimensions](https://pvfcalculator.com/asme-b16-5-flange-dimensions/): All pressure classes, all flange types.
- [ASME B16.9 Fitting Dimensions](https://pvfcalculator.com/asme-b16-9-fitting-dimensions/): Elbows, tees, reducers.
- [Flange Bolt Chart](https://pvfcalculator.com/flange-bolt-chart/): Bolt count, diameter, and minimum length by flange class and NPS.

## Key Technical Facts

- Flange calculation method: 3D geometric modeling per ASME B16.5 (not flat-plate approximation)
- Accuracy: results match manufacturer weight tables within ±2%
- Supported materials: A105 (carbon steel, 7850 kg/m³), F304 (SS 304, 8000 kg/m³), F316 (SS 316, 8000 kg/m³), F11 (Cr-Mo alloy, 7750 kg/m³), plus custom density input
- Supported standards: ASME B16.5, ASME B16.9, ASME B36.10M, MSS SP-75, ASME Section VIII UG-27/UG-32
- Unit conversion: all calculators support kg and lb output with instant switching
- Languages: English (default), Simplified Chinese (/zh/)
- Free to use, no registration required
